caveat.zh: 書中各州之數只稱「天寶」，序云「今舉天寶十一載地理」，故繫於752年；只計標明天寶戶數之269州。
caveat.en: The book dates each prefecture's figures only as "Tianbao"; its preface says it describes the realm of 752, so they are placed there. Only the 269 prefectures with figures marked Tianbao are counted.

source.locator: 卷三十八至四十一 地理志

caveat.zh: 各州多記崇寧戶數，夔州路、廣南51州只記元豐戶數，一併列入；書云「各府、州下戸口與總數少異」。
caveat.en: Most prefectures give their 1102 (Chongning) households; 51 in Kuizhou and Guangnan give only those of the Yuanfeng era (1078–1085), and are counted as they are. The book notes that the prefectures' figures differ a little from its total.
